item.title: Wing Back (Outside Back)
item.description: The wing back (also called an outside back or halfback) controls the outside of the formation on the left or right. The back closest to the wall at any moment is the inside back; the one furthest from the wall is the openside back. These labels swap as the puck moves — see Backs in the 3-3 for how the Seven formation lines up. In the Seven formation, the strong-side back (the back on the puck side) is usually on the bottom.

item.title: Swing Back (Center Back)
item.description: The swing back (also called the center back or fullback) controls the middle of the formation. You are primarily a defender, but you can attack forward when you see the opportunity. See Backs in the 3-3 for how the swing fits into the Seven formation and when to rotate in for the strong-side back. Your partners are the two wing backs — you must always be ready to support them, and you can also support the forwards and pivot as needed.
